description: Land Title Settlement Department - Balagalla, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510006
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, and ownership details) in various villages. The content focuses on land ownership registration, property boundaries, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
